g.text: HTTP clients, 3 web helper traits, no steps
A consuming project extends DrupalContext or WebContext for
the whole vocabulary, or extends WebRawContext and mixes in
only the traits it needs. Each trait declares what it needs
for a backend, RawMinkContext for a Mink session only, and
composes the helper traits its own body calls.
Step traits never use other step traits. Shared logic lives
in the concern-named helper traits, composed by whichever
step traits and contexts need it. A trait's directory is its
classification: src/Steps registers Gherkin, src/Steps/Helper does
not, and the Web and Drupal halves say which context a
